As with other compositions in the *Cariyāpiṭaka*, it forms part of the later strata of canonical sutta literature and recounts the bodily, verbal, and mental conduct of the Bodhisatta across his past lives [SuttaCentral].

In modern scholarship and translation, the text is represented on SuttaCentral by three translations across three different languages, including an English translation by Bhikkhu Sujato titled *The Conduct of Golden Sāma* [SuttaCentral].
